bot_deployment_events_status_check.name: bot_deployment_events_status_check
bot_deployment_events_status_check.value:
("bot_deployment_events"."from_status" IS NULL OR "bot_deployment_events"."from_status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'STOPPED', 'RETIRED'))
        AND "bot_deployment_events"."to_status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'STOPPED', 'RETIRED')

bot_session_events_message_check.name: bot_session_events_message_check
bot_session_events_message_check.value:
("bot_session_events"."kind" NOT IN ('INPUT_ACCEPTED', 'INPUT_REJECTED', 'PROMPT_INTERACTION')
        OR "bot_session_events"."message_id" IS NOT NULL) IS TRUE

bot_session_events_values_check.name: bot_session_events_values_check
bot_session_events_values_check.value: ("bot_session_events"."code" IS NULL OR "bot_session_events"."code" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$') AND ("bot_session_events"."step_seq" IS NULL OR "bot_session_events"."step_seq" >= 0)

bot_sessions_tokens_check.name: bot_sessions_tokens_check
bot_sessions_tokens_check.value:
("bot_sessions"."awaiting_token" IS NULL OR "bot_sessions"."awaiting_token" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$')
        AND ("bot_sessions"."last_consumed_token" IS NULL OR "bot_sessions"."last_consumed_token" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$')

bot_sessions_terminal_fields_check.name: bot_sessions_terminal_fields_check
bot_sessions_terminal_fields_check.value:
(("bot_sessions"."state" IN ('COMPLETED', 'HANDED_OVER', 'FAILED')) = ("bot_sessions"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("bot_sessions"."state" IN ('COMPLETED', 'HANDED_OVER', 'FAILED')) = ("bot_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL)) IS TRUE

bot_sessions_end_reason_state_check.name: bot_sessions_end_reason_state_check
bot_sessions_end_reason_state_check.value:
("bot_sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL
        OR ("bot_sessions"."state" = 'COMPLETED' AND "bot_sessions"."end_reason" IN ('flow_end', 'idle_timeout', 'conversation_resolved', 'error'))
        OR ("bot_sessions"."state" = 'HANDED_OVER' AND "bot_sessions"."end_reason" IN ('flow_handover', 'system_handover', 'error'))
        OR ("bot_sessions"."state" = 'FAILED' AND "bot_sessions"."end_reason" = 'error')) IS TRUE

bot_sessions_handover_reason_check.name: bot_sessions_handover_reason_check
bot_sessions_handover_reason_check.value:
(("bot_sessions"."state" = 'HANDED_OVER') = ("bot_sessions"."handover_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("bot_sessions"."handover_reason" IS NULL OR "bot_sessions"."handover_reason" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$')
        AND ("bot_sessions"."state" <> 'HANDED_OVER'
          OR ("bot_sessions"."end_reason" = 'flow_handover') = ("bot_sessions"."handover_reason" IN ('student_requested', 'needs_staff', 'out_of_scope', 'invalid_input', 'error_fallback', 'other')))) IS TRUE

bot_sessions_terminal_notice_check.name: bot_sessions_terminal_notice_check
bot_sessions_terminal_notice_check.value:
"bot_sessions"."terminal_notice_step_seq" IS NULL OR ("bot_sessions"."terminal_notice_step_seq" = "bot_sessions"."step_seq"
        AND "bot_sessions"."state" IN ('COMPLETED', 'HANDED_OVER')
        AND "bot_sessions"."end_reason" IN ('flow_end', 'flow_handover')) IS TRUE

bot_sessions_redacted_check.name: bot_sessions_redacted_check
bot_sessions_redacted_check.value:
"bot_sessions"."redacted_at" IS NULL OR ("bot_sessions"."state" IN ('COMPLETED', 'HANDED_OVER', 'FAILED')
        AND "bot_sessions"."variables" = '{}'::jsonb AND "bot_sessions"."awaiting" IS NULL
        AND "bot_sessions"."awaiting_token" IS NULL AND "bot_sessions"."last_consumed_token" IS NULL) IS TRUE

bot_triggers_claim_check.name: bot_triggers_claim_check
bot_triggers_claim_check.value: (("bot_triggers"."claim_token" IS NULL) = ("bot_triggers"."claimed_at" IS NULL)) IS TRUE

bot_triggers_lifecycle_check.name: bot_triggers_lifecycle_check
bot_triggers_lifecycle_check.value:
(("bot_triggers"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "bot_triggers"."processed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("bot_triggers"."status" <> 'PENDING' AND "bot_triggers"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bot_triggers"."claim_token" IS NULL)) IS TRUE

bot_triggers_dead_check.name: bot_triggers_dead_check
bot_triggers_dead_check.value: ("bot_triggers"."status" <> 'DEAD' OR "bot_triggers"."outcome_code" IS NOT NULL) IS TRUE

bot_triggers_codes_check.name: bot_triggers_codes_check
bot_triggers_codes_check.value:
("bot_triggers"."outcome_code" IS NULL OR "bot_triggers"."outcome_code" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$')
        AND ("bot_triggers"."last_error_code" IS NULL OR "bot_triggers"."last_error_code" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$')

bots_draft_shape_check.name: bots_draft_shape_check
bots_draft_shape_check.value:
(("bots"."draft_config_canonical" IS NULL) = ("bots"."draft_updated_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("bots"."draft_updated_at" IS NULL) = ("bots"."draft_updated_by_membership_id" IS NULL)) IS TRUE

conversation_events_status_values_check.name: conversation_events_status_values_check
conversation_events_status_values_check.value:
("conversation_events"."from_status" IS NULL OR "conversation_events"."from_status" IN ('OPEN', 'PENDING', 'RESOLVED'))
        AND ("conversation_events"."to_status" IS NULL OR "conversation_events"."to_status" IN ('OPEN', 'PENDING', 'RESOLVED'))

conversation_events_shape_check.name: conversation_events_shape_check
conversation_events_shape_check.value:
("conversation_events"."kind" = 'ASSIGNMENT'
            AND "conversation_events"."from_status" IS NULL AND "conversation_events"."to_status" IS NULL
            AND "conversation_events"."from_assignee_membership_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "conversation_events"."to_assignee_membership_id")
          OR ("conversation_events"."kind" = 'STATUS'
            AND "conversation_events"."from_assignee_membership_id" IS NULL AND "conversation_events"."to_assignee_membership_id" IS NULL
            AND "conversation_events"."from_status" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_events"."to_status" IS NOT NULL
            AND "conversation_events"."from_status" <> "conversation_events"."to_status")

lead_attributions_unlinked_ad_idx.name: lead_attributions_unlinked_ad_idx
lead_attributions_unlinked_ad_idx.where: "lead_attributions"."lead_id" IS NULL AND "lead_attributions"."source_type" = 'META_AD' AND "lead_attributions"."message_id" IS NOT NULL

lead_events_status_values_check.name: lead_events_status_values_check
lead_events_status_values_check.value:
("lead_events"."from_status" IS NULL OR "lead_events"."from_status" IN ('NEW', 'QUALIFIED', 'INTERESTED', 'NOT_INTERESTED', 'NO_RESPONSE', 'INVALID'))
        AND ("lead_events"."to_status" IS NULL OR "lead_events"."to_status" IN ('NEW', 'QUALIFIED', 'INTERESTED', 'NOT_INTERESTED', 'NO_RESPONSE', 'INVALID'))

lead_events_shape_check.name: lead_events_shape_check
lead_events_shape_check.value:
(("lead_events"."kind" = 'CREATED'
            AND "lead_events"."from_status" IS NULL AND "lead_events"."to_status" IS NULL
            AND "lead_events"."revision" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_events"."revision" = 0
            AND "lead_events"."origin" IS NOT NULL
            AND (("lead_events"."origin" = 'MANUAL' AND "lead_events"."actor_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_events"."attribution_id" IS NULL)
              OR ("lead_events"."origin" = 'AD_REFERRAL' AND "lead_events"."actor_membership_id" IS NULL AND "lead_events"."attribution_id" IS NOT NULL)))
          OR ("lead_events"."kind" = 'STATUS'
            AND "lead_events"."origin" IS NULL AND "lead_events"."attribution_id" IS NULL AND "lead_events"."actor_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "lead_events"."from_status" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_events"."to_status" IS NOT NULL
            AND "lead_events"."from_status" <> "lead_events"."to_status"
            AND "lead_events"."revision" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_events"."revision" >= 1)
          OR ("lead_events"."kind" = 'TOUCH_LINKED'
            AND "lead_events"."origin" IS NULL AND "lead_events"."attribution_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "lead_events"."from_status" IS NULL AND "lead_events"."to_status" IS NULL AND "lead_events"."revision" IS NULL)) IS TRUE

lead_reconcile_decisions_shape_check.name: lead_reconcile_decisions_shape_check
lead_reconcile_decisions_shape_check.value:
(("lead_reconcile_decisions"."decision" = 'RETRY'
            AND "lead_reconcile_decisions"."attempts" BETWEEN 1 AND 4
            AND "lead_reconcile_decisions"."next_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("lead_reconcile_decisions"."decision" = 'PARKED'
            AND "lead_reconcile_decisions"."attempts" = 5
            AND "lead_reconcile_decisions"."next_attempt_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("lead_reconcile_decisions"."decision" IN ('SKIPPED_STALE', 'SKIPPED_BEFORE_CYCLE', 'SKIPPED_CONVERTED', 'SKIPPED_ARCHIVED')
            AND "lead_reconcile_decisions"."attempts" BETWEEN 0 AND 4
            AND "lead_reconcile_decisions"."next_attempt_at" IS NULL)) IS TRUE

outbound_requests_codes_check.name: outbound_requests_codes_check
outbound_requests_codes_check.value:
("outbound_requests"."hold_reason" IS NULL OR "outbound_requests"."hold_reason" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$')
        AND ("outbound_requests"."failure_code" IS NULL OR "outbound_requests"."failure_code" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$')
        AND ("outbound_requests"."provider_error_code" IS NULL OR char_length("outbound_requests"."provider_error_code") <= 64)
        AND ("outbound_requests"."provider_message_status" IS NULL OR char_length("outbound_requests"."provider_message_status") <= 64)

outbound_requests_lifecycle_check.name: outbound_requests_lifecycle_check
outbound_requests_lifecycle_check.value:
("outbound_requests"."state" <> 'HELD' OR "outbound_requests"."hold_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("outbound_requests"."state" <> 'REJECTED' OR "outbound_requests"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("outbound_requests"."state" <> 'SENDING' OR ("outbound_requests"."claimed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_requests"."send_started_at" IS NOT NULL))
        AND ("outbound_requests"."state" <> 'QUEUED' OR "outbound_requests"."claimed_by" IS NULL)
        AND ("outbound_requests"."state" <> 'ACCEPTED' OR ("outbound_requests"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_requests"."send_started_at" IS NOT NULL))
        AND ("outbound_requests"."state" <> 'UNKNOWN_OUTCOME' OR "outbound_requests"."send_started_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("outbound_requests"."state" NOT IN ('ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'HELD', 'UNKNOWN_OUTCOME') OR "outbound_requests"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)
